verdict.rationale: monday.com is a work-management and agent-orchestration platform, so AI code-diff review with sectioned explanations is a code-review-tool axis outside its category. The closest evidence only links GitHub/GitLab pull requests to monday items, and the generic agent-building features never mention analyzing or explaining code diffs. Neither shows the product actually shipping this capability, so the axis does not flip to applicable.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can have AI break a code diff into focused sections with explanations of what changed and why
